title: Could support for RSS/Atom be added to Thunderbird for Android, like desktop?
creator: rickard.pontus.olof.lind
content: RSS/Atom works well for me in Thunderbird [for desktop]. Could support for this please be added to Thunderbird for Android?

title: why can't I sync or download emails
creator: tjblondestorm
content: I'm not getting my emails. When i try to sync, it just blinks. I use the latest version on my Samsung S24 note ultra. I've thoroughly enjoyed Thunderbird except for this intermittent issue.
